task: T238 independent exact-real centering theorem and source review

findings.inverse_law: Positive cumulative increments d_j/S and inverse-linear interpolation give a continuous interval-uniform mixture, with conditional midpoint x_j-Delta/2; not a discrete endpoint law.
findings.central_cdf: Pair reflected ordinates with S=2L+d_m+d_N. The lower-half sum L+d_m gives gap (d_m-d_N)/(2S). Continuous latent endpoints have zero mass.
findings.gaussian_lower_bound: The formal T2 kind12 Gaussian has d_N/d_m=exp(-64), S<=N*d_m. Therefore gap>1/(4N)=1/640000 at N160000; exp(64)>2 follows symbolically, with no Gaussian evaluation. This is also a sup-event total-variation lower bound for either symmetric normalized target law.
findings.mean: The full symmetric endpoint first moment vanishes; dropping j0 contributes A*d_N. Subtracting the half-cell midpoint shift gives A*d_N/S-Delta/2. Constant ordinates cancel exactly; center-heavy ordinates satisfying the specified inequality give negative mean.
findings.asymptotics: For continuous positive even d on fixed bounded [-A,A], Delta*S tends to its integral by right Riemann sums; dividing the exact formulas by Delta proves the two displayed limits. No finite-grid error bound follows.
findings.rescue: Trapezoidal weights satisfy a_j=a_(N+1-j); reflected intervals have equal probabilities and opposite midpoints. Hence the continuous interpolated law is symmetric with CDF0=1/2 and mean0. Equal endpoints give W=S exactly.
findings.normalizers: The source base cumulative integral is Delta*(S+d0); source Z further multiplies this by npos12 or npos23. The normalized inverse CDF uses S, while trapezoidal base integration uses Delta*S for equal endpoints. Changing the inverse CDF alone does not fix or certify Z.
findings.scope: Actual floating grid/ordinates/cumsum/interpolation and finite Sobol/RNG law are not assumed equal to the formal symmetric model. Centering does not establish Gaussian-law equality, all-integrand accuracy, trained bias, cost advantage or estimator adoption. T>2 densities require checking their own symmetry; the statement generally asymmetric does not exclude special symmetric cases.

method: Written algebra, source-text inspection and exact Git/file byte provenance only.
